name: Genre EQ
text: Each genre's fader (x{step}) is added to that genre's songs.

name: Decade EQ
text: Each decade's fader (x{step}) is added to that decade's songs.

name: CD Burner
text: Once per gig: turn a Mix in your hand into a copy of an album in your hand.

name: Looper
text: Your final song scores x{mult} if it shares a genre or decade with the slot 1 song.

name: Overdrive
text: +{points} points per song.

name: Tube Preamp
text: +1 point per song for each different genre in your hand (max +{max}).

name: Phaser
text: +{flow} flow if the song before has the same decade.

name: Tuner
text: +{discards} discard each gig.

name: Make Some Noise
text: Every song scores +{points}.

name: Fog Machine
text: Your opener raises flow by {flow}.

name: Delay Pedal
text: Two songs of the same genre back to back: the next song scores x{mult}.

name: Merch Table
text: ${cash} at the end of each gig.

name: Tip Jar
text: ${cash} per unused discard when the show ends.

name: T Shirt Cannon
text: Slot 3 earns no points, but earns money equal to its base points.

name: Octave
text: Songs of one genre also count as another.

name: Sampler
text: Songs of one genre pay ${cash} when they follow another.

name: Reverb
text: +1 point per earlier song of the same genre (max +{max}).

name: Audio Interface
text: "The song above" also works in slots 1 to 3.

name: Noise Gate
text: Each gig, {count} random hated tag is ignored. Off when the boss has the hates ability.

name: Request Line
text: Requests pay +{pays} points instead of +10.

name: Vintage Amp
text: Gains +{store} flow each time a {decade} song is played. Adds to your starting flow.

name: Feedback
text: Gains +{store} flow each time a {genre} song is played. Adds to your starting flow.

name: Piggy Bank
text: The pot gains ${cash} each gig. Selling it or beating a boss pays it out.

name: Deep Library
text: Once per gig: redraw your whole hand.

name: Sneak Peek
text: Once per gig: look at the next {count} songs in your binder.

name: Stack Amp
text: Each {genre} song scores +{points} per other {genre} song in the set.

name: Turntables
text: After each {genre} song, flow rises by {flow}.

name: Radio
text: Each {genre} song pays ${cash}.

name: Saxophone
text: Jazz songs count as any genre for their neighbors' conditions.

name: Splitter
text: Duplicates the unit to its right.

name: Wah Pedal
text: After every song, flow rises by {flow} for each unit to its left.
